name: UniMatch
paper_title: Unifying Flow, Stereo and Depth Estimation
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license: the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products, provided the copyright and license notice travel with copies. The upstream unimatch/ package at commit 943a9900 is vendored verbatim under libreyolo/models/unimatch/_vendor/ with its MIT LICENSE; LibreYOLO's wrapper code is also MIT. Upstream publishes the GMFlow checkpoints (gmflow-scale1-things as s, gmflow-scale2-regrefine6-mixdata as l, plus its Sintel and KITTI-2015 fine-tunes) without a separate weight license, so LibreYOLO hosts them on its Hugging Face org under the releasing project's MIT license: an implied grant, disclosed as LibreYOLO's interpretation and not confirmed by the publisher. No gating; only the optical flow task is wired, and training is out of scope.
